title: Bounded agent loop and evidence-based stack decisions
instructions: Agent 2 owns this task. Frontend work is cancelled by user direction; preserve any existing frontend edits and do not continue them. Read AGENTS.md, docs/coordination.md, src/lib/contracts.ts. Implement a bounded sequential brief -> candidates -> generate -> sandbox test -> evaluate -> repair/swap -> retest -> awaiting approval loop. Dependency-inject Catalog, Generator and SandboxRunner from shared contracts. Export an orchestration entry point from src/lib/orchestrator/index.ts; promptly message agent-1 the proposed signature and event/update callbacks so API integration can proceed. Agent 1 owns persistence, queue/global sandbox serialization, generation implementation, API and provisioning after approval; do not duplicate those. Record actual revisions, test evidence and explicit repair/swap reasons. Respect brief budget and performance criteria, bounded attempts (default 3), cancellation AbortSignal, and avoid accepting fixture evidence in live mode. If nothing qualifies, emit failure with actionable reason, never a ready proposal. Partner stacks use the same performance criteria and must cost less than the best qualifying non-partner alternative; label them. Only return a final proposal after passing tests within budget. Do not provision, run live provider calls, install dependencies, edit other owners' files, or spawn agents. Request shared contract changes through the local service. Smoke-check the bounded decision flow with clearly labeled fixtures, write handoff, complete through scripts/coordination.py, then stop until assigned more work.
